messages:
sam: Heads up — quick canary run of q4b-int4-2026 vs promptset-v5 shows ~6% drop on our QA pass metric vs golden. Snapshot uploaded to /artifacts/q4b_smoke. Suspect tokenizer parity + a dedupe collision.

lia: Oof. Any tokenizer/vocab diffs? We merged tokeniser-v2 last week.

sam: I diffed token counts for failing samples. Lots of long prompts where whitespace normalization changed tokenization -> different token lengths and likely KV-cache misalignment. Also found duplicated sample IDs in the canary set (dedupe bloom false positives).

kevin: Can you paste the eval command you ran? I'll repro locally and run a quant calibration sweep.

sam: ```./tools/eval_canary.sh --model q4b-int4-2026 --promptset promptset-v5 --golden golden_v3.json --output=/tmp/q4b_scan.json --seed=42```
Also ran: `python -m redwood.tools.token_check --prompt prompt_id=abc123 --model q4b-int4-2026`

julia: Labeling queue note: we already saw some dup IDs — might be a backfill re-ingest. @lia can we quarantine affected shards and re-run dedupe? Need to freeze golden until relabel completes.

lia: Yes, putting a hold on ingestion for promptset-v5 shard-12 and shard-13. Re-running dedupe with updated fuzzyhash threshold now. ETA ~25m.

labeler-bot: auto: 7 items flagged for relabel in shard-12 (priority: high) — created task LABEL-9876.

kevin: Meanwhile I'll run a quant smoke with two knobs: disable kernel fuse and disable KV-cache warmup. If regressions go away that's a runtime interaction.

sam: Also saw two cases where prefix caching returned shorter continuations; could be KVCACHE eviction timing difference under quant. @ops-bot can you check GPU mem reclaim logs around 17:18 UTC yesterday?

ops-bot: logs queried. Found 3 OOM_reclaim events on cluster-gpux-07 at 17:17:52. Suspected preemption window related to nvidia-driver 535.1. Rolling patch in progress.

julia: For labeling — propose a micro-golden refresh: 200 high-impact samples (failures + near-miss) to have senior labelers re-annotate. That should stabilize evals quickly.

lia: Agree. Creating micro-golden list now. Will include token-diff examples and dup candidates.

sam: Timeline suggestion: lia dedupe 25m, kevin quant smoke 30m, julia assemble micro-golden 40m. If both point to tokenizer/dedupe, hold q4b-int4 rollout, patch tokenizer normalization + dedupe bloom params, then rebaseline.

kevin: Running: ```python -m redwood.eval.run --model q4b-int4-2026 --flags "fuse_kernels=False,kv_warmup=False" --out /tmp/q4b_smoke.json``` Will post results when finished.

sam: If you want to inspect token diffs locally: `python -c 'from redwood import tokenizer; print(tokenizer.diff("\\n"," \\n"))'` :eyes:

julia: Tagging @eng-sre lead to watch infra patch in case it impacts other canaries.

kevin: Quick interim fix: I added a pre-selection de-dup by original-source-checksum to eval harness so duplicate IDs are filtered before sample selection. PR coming.

lia: PR looks good. https://github.com/redwood-inference/curation/pull/482 — will merge after green tests.

sam: I'll block the canary route in Console and add a rollout note: 'rollback if golden delta > 5%'.

julia: Thanks team :thumbsup:
